text:
Radiance joins us in this bonfire

that your alabaster makes transparent and gilds,

and in most joyful tongues devours

a vineyard of dead spring.


Stars of swiftest course

slide in your eyes, and all your being

explores me as a tempting ember,

the heart that waits consumed.


Beloved without secret, so near,

I see you intimate and open, in a sunset

that the sun makes within yourself, how


your burning sap flows beneath clean satin;

and I make a vine shoot of my love, which wins

gold for the thirst in which I burn.

translation.title: How Your Burning Sap Flows
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the erotic vineyard, alabaster, sap, satin, and burning thirst.
